title: Activation-scale bridge and runtime compatibility for INT8 rollout
creator: Emily Chen
description: Problem: When enabling activation-aware INT8 (SmoothQuant-style) profiles for deployed transformer models we observe two operational risks: 1) runtime kernels that assume static per-tensor scales break on models with per-channel activation rescaling, causing correctness regressions; 2) calibration profiles generated offline drift from production input distributions, causing hidden accuracy drops after rollout. Goal: implement a robust pipeline and runtime bridge that produces validated per-layer activation-rescale profiles during calibration, ships runtime compatibility shims/hotpatchable kernels, and gates rollout via canary metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration pipeline produces per-layer activation-rescale maps (.rescale.json) for target models and stores artifacts in S3 with provenance metadata.
Runtime accepts a rescale manifest and applies per-layer activation scaling transparently to INT8 microkernels without requiring model graph changes.
Fallback path to FP16 runtime if kernel compatibility check fails at load time or if live accuracy gate indicates regression.
Automated ML-quality test (delta-bleu / perplexity / embedding-similarity) runs as part of CI and blocks release on >0.5% quality regression for customer-facing LLMs.
Canary rollout dashboard shows token-level accuracy, latency, and cost delta; automatic rollback policy triggers on sustained quality drop or latency SLO breach.
End-to-end performance validation demonstrates <=5% p95 latency regression and >=20% per-token cost improvement in representative workloads compared to FP16 baseline for INT8-enabled path.
tasks: Design calibration harness: sampling, input filters, tokenization parity with production, warmup lengths (PRD: designs/confluence/activation-scale-harness)
Implement profile generator: collect activation statistics, compute per-channel rescale factors, export stable manifest with checksums and sample histograms
Add runtime bridge: kernel wrapper that reads manifest and applies rescale before existing INT8 matmul kernels; implement load-time compatibility checks
Hotpatchable kernel deployment: allow shipping kernel fixes without model recompile; add tests for atomic swap and fallback
CI & E2E tests: correctness suite (bit-diff where possible), quality evals on heldout prompt set, perf sweep across batch sizes and seq lengths
Console & telemetry: expose per-route canary metrics, register rollout gating rules, surface drift alerts when production distribution deviates from calibration dataset
